hypotheses.construction_plan: Substitute the function parameter f by the declared function name a or b in the template K(n)*f(n), leaving n symbolic.
required_assumptions: K, a, and b are unary functions of n
Multiplication of function values is well-defined
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands share the common factor K(n), so they are specializations of a single kernel product K(n)*f(n). The full expression is a sum of two such specializations.
